projects.name: Finly
projects.tagline: An AI expense tracker for iPhone and Android.
problem: Expense trackers ask for a lot of typing or for your bank login, and people stop logging after a week. Finly makes entry nearly free: say it, photograph it, or import a statement, then confirm.
built: Voice entry, receipt scanning and PDF or CSV statement import, each turning raw input into draft transactions.
Receipt scanning is one vision-model call that returns a JSON array of drafts, matched to the user’s own categories. Nothing saves until the user confirms.
A tool-calling assistant that confirms before it writes. The model proposes; the server holds the action behind a short-lived token until the user taps confirm.
A React Native and Expo app for iPhone and Android, talking to a Node and Express API on Postgres with Prisma.
Statement imports run as background jobs on Redis and BullMQ, so a big PDF never blocks the app.
OpenAI and Anthropic models behind the API, with Whisper for voice.
A self-hosted over-the-air update server on Railway, so fixes reach users without a store review.

projects.name: Investolio
projects.tagline: A dividend and portfolio tracker for iOS, Android and web.
problem: Dividend investors keep asking what they will be paid, and when. The answer lives across brokerage statements and spreadsheets, and it needs prices from a data feed that is not free.
built: An Interactive Brokers sync, so a portfolio arrives without retyping a position.
Offline-first: the app reads from an on-device cache, opens with no connection and syncs in the background.
A market-data service of its own, with no API keys: prices, dividends and FX from free public sources, each with an ordered fallback, stored in Postgres.
Dividends are merged from two sources, with a tolerance so a one-day ex-date disagreement is not counted twice.
A dividend calendar, income forecasts and a per-holding dividend rating.
One Expo and React Native codebase for iOS, Android and web.

projects.name: Reelife
problem: Reelife is a Shopify app that merchants install from the App Store and use inside their admin. It bills through Shopify and gives them a real-time dashboard.
built: A Remix frontend embedded in the Shopify admin.
Nest.js microservices behind it, packaged with Docker and run on Kubernetes.
Hosted on AWS.
Subscriptions through the Shopify Billing API.
A real-time dashboard for merchants.

commonQuestions.question: What has Raffay shipped?
commonQuestions.answer: Three products of his own. Finly (2025 to now) is an AI expense tracker for iPhone and Android with voice entry, receipt scanning, PDF and CSV statement import and an assistant that confirms before it writes. Investolio (2026 to now, in beta) is a dividend and portfolio tracker for iOS, Android and web. Reelife (June 2023 to now) is an app for Shopify merchants. Before that he shipped for other companies: Trafilea, Planto and Netsol.

commonQuestions.question: What’s his experience with AI in production?
commonQuestions.answer: Finly runs LLM features in production: voice entry with Whisper, receipt scanning with a vision model that returns draft transactions, PDF and CSV statement import, and a tool-calling assistant that confirms before it writes. It uses OpenAI and Anthropic models behind a Node API. He writes about it on the Tiercel journal, including receipt scanning in production and assistants that confirm before they write.

commonQuestions.question: Is he open to partner work?
commonQuestions.answer: Yes. Tiercel, the company he founded, partners with companies that want to build their own AI-powered apps. The way to start is to email contact@raffaysajjad.com.

commonQuestions.question: What stack does he use?
commonQuestions.answer: On the front end: React, Next.js, Remix, React Native with Expo, and TypeScript. On the back end: Node, Nest and Express, GraphQL, Postgres with Prisma, and Redis with BullMQ. For infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and Railway. For AI: OpenAI and Anthropic tool calling, vision extraction and Whisper. He also builds with Cursor, Claude Code and Codex.
